prompt: Choose the word that best completes the sentence.
context: No payment of that size may be authorised without the express ____ of the finance committee, and any officer who ignores the rule faces dismissal.
explanation: sanction 是著名的反義同形字：複數的 sanctions 幾乎一律指制裁，但單數不可數時（official sanction、without the sanction of…）指的是官方核准。此處 without the express ____ of the committee 需要的正是「核准」這一義。

distractorExplanations.a: penalty 是對違規者施加的處罰，句意會變成「未經委員會處罰就不得付款」，邏輯不通。
distractorExplanations.c: embargo 專指禁運或禁令，是一種限制而非許可，而且要說 impose an embargo on something。
distractorExplanations.d: concession 指談判中的讓步或政府特許經營權，不用來指例行的核准程序。

prompt: Choose the word that best completes the sentence.
context: Poor labelling of the samples seriously ____ the investigation, forcing the team to repeat three months of work before any conclusions could be drawn.
explanation: impede 的受詞是「正在進行的過程」（impede progress / an investigation），表示使其受阻、變慢但仍在進行；句中調查還得重做三個月的工作，正是被拖慢而非被勸退。

distractorExplanations.a: deter 作用在「人的意願」上，靠嚇阻使人打消念頭，因此該行為根本不會發生，與調查仍在繼續矛盾。
distractorExplanations.b: discourage 同樣是讓人失去意願，受詞若不是人就得是「被勸退而未發生的行為」，無法描述進度受阻。
distractorExplanations.c: dissuade 的句型固定為 dissuade somebody from doing something，受詞必須是人，不能接 the investigation。

prompt: Choose the word that best completes the sentence.
context: Falling tax receipts forced the ministry to ____ spending on new infrastructure, cutting the programme from twelve projects to four over two years.
explanation: curtail 的受詞是可增減的規模、數量或權利（curtail spending / services / freedoms），指「砍到剩下一部分」，與句尾從十二個專案減為四個完全吻合。

distractorExplanations.a: abbreviate 只用於把字詞或文句縮短（abbreviate a title），不能以 spending 為受詞。
distractorExplanations.b: truncate 指把末端截掉，受詞多為文字、資料或幾何形體，強調「被切斷」而非有計畫地縮減。
distractorExplanations.d: abolish 是徹底廢除、一個不留，與句中「減為四個」的部分保留互相矛盾。

prompt: Choose the word that best completes the sentence.
context: Many junior lecturers ____ their salaries with consultancy work, since the university pay scale has not been revised for almost a decade.
explanation: augment 的句型是 augment something with something：被增加的既有數量放在動詞後，用來增補的來源由 with 帶出，augment one’s income 正是最常見的搭配。

distractorExplanations.a: compensate 的受詞若是人表示「補償某人」，若要說補足不足則須用 compensate for something，不能直接接 salaries。
distractorExplanations.b: subsidize 的主語必須是提供補助的第三方（政府、學校），而不是自己去接案的講師本人。
distractorExplanations.d: reimburse 指把某人已經墊付的費用退還給他，受詞是人（reimburse somebody for something），與加薪無關。

prompt: Choose the word that best completes the sentence.
context: The fresh evidence from the second trial did much to ____ confidence in a drug that regulators had come close to withdrawing last year.
explanation: bolster 是及物動詞，可直接接抽象受詞，bolster confidence in something 是固定搭配，語氣中性，指讓原本存在的信心更穩固。

distractorExplanations.b: brace 用於撐住實體結構，或以 brace oneself for something 表示做好心理準備，不能直接接 confidence。
distractorExplanations.c: prop 此義必須用片語動詞 prop up，而且常帶有「靠外力勉強硬撐」的負面暗示。
distractorExplanations.d: shore 同樣必須說 shore up something，單獨使用時是名詞「岸」，不具支撐之意。

options.text: She is meticulous with checking every figure against the original invoices.
The archivist was meticulous to record the provenance of every single item.
The report was meticulous of every discrepancy that the auditors had found.
He is meticulous in preparing the monthly accounts, and errors are very rare.

explanation: meticulous 有兩個標準句型：meticulous in + 動名詞（在做某事時一絲不苟）與 meticulous about + 名詞（對某事極為講究），另可直接修飾名詞（meticulous records）。

distractorExplanations.a: 接動名詞時要用 in，不是 with：meticulous in checking every figure。
distractorExplanations.b: meticulous 不接不定詞；要表達「仔細記錄」應說 meticulous in recording the provenance。
distractorExplanations.c: meticulous 不搭配 of；若要帶出講究的對象，介系詞是 about：meticulous about every discrepancy。

prompt: Choose the word that best completes the sentence.
context: After the third round of talks collapsed, the mediators concluded that further negotiation would be ____ and recommended that the case go to arbitration.
explanation: futile 形容「不論再怎麼做都不會有結果」的行動，主語限定為 negotiation、attempt、effort 這類行為名詞，正好說明調解人為何改推仲裁。

distractorExplanations.b: idle 此義修飾的是言談（idle talk / threats / speculation），指「說說而已、不會付諸行動」，不用來評斷一項行動有無成效。
distractorExplanations.c: feeble 說的是力道薄弱、不夠有力，一個薄弱的嘗試仍可能奏效，與「注定無用」不同。
distractorExplanations.d: void 屬法律語域，指契約或條款失去效力（null and void），不能用來形容談判本身。

prompt: Choose the word that best completes the sentence.
context: Most of the post is taken up with necessary but ____ administrative chores; the research that first attracted her occupies perhaps one afternoon a week.
explanation: mundane 的評價軸是「有趣／無趣」：指例行、平淡、缺乏刺激的事務，與句中令她嚮往的研究工作形成對照，也與前面的 necessary 並不衝突。

distractorExplanations.a: trivial 的評價軸是「重不重要」，說某事無足輕重，與句中 necessary 直接牴觸。
distractorExplanations.b: menial 指不需技術、地位低下的勞務（打掃、跑腿），帶有貶低身分的意味，不適用於行政事務。
distractorExplanations.d: obscure 指晦澀難懂或默默無名，說的是理解難度或知名度，與工作是否乏味無關。

prompt: Choose the word that best completes the sentence.
context: The pump's output became increasingly ____ over the week: it delivered the correct dose twice, then far too little, then nothing at all.
explanation: erratic 說的是「毫無規律、時好時壞、無法預測」，主語可以是機器、表現或天候，冒號後三種截然不同的結果正是這種不規律性。

distractorExplanations.a: erroneous 指內容有誤（erroneous data / assumption），評斷的是對錯，無法描述忽多忽少的變動。
distractorExplanations.b: errant 指偏離正軌的單一人事物（an errant email、an errant husband），不描述一連串起伏的表現。
distractorExplanations.c: eccentric 形容人的行為舉止古怪，主語限於人，不能用來描述幫浦的輸出。

prompt: Choose the word that best completes the sentence.
context: The sudden silence on the trading floor felt ____; within the hour, three of the largest banks had suspended withdrawals altogether.
explanation: ominous 的核心是時間指向未來：它說某個跡象「預示壞事將要發生」。後半句在一小時內成真的擠兌，正是這個預兆應驗的結果。

distractorExplanations.a: solemn 指莊嚴肅穆的場合氣氛（葬禮、宣誓），是一種鄭重，不含任何不祥的預告。
distractorExplanations.b: sombre 描述當下陰鬱低沉的情緒或色調，說的是此刻的心情，而不是對後續發展的預示。
distractorExplanations.c: grim 評斷的是已經擺在眼前的嚴峻現況或表情（grim news / a grim look），同樣沒有「預兆」的時間指向。

options.text: The chief executive was unusually candid about the company's cash-flow problems.
The chief executive was unusually candid of the company's cash-flow problems.
The chief executive candid the company's cash-flow problems to the whole board.
The chief executive was candid with admitting that the forecasts had been optimistic.

explanation: candid 指「對不好開口的事也照實說」，帶出所談主題時固定用 be candid about + 名詞，也可直接修飾名詞（a candid interview / assessment）。

distractorExplanations.b: candid 不搭配 of；表示「對某事坦白」的介系詞是 about。
distractorExplanations.c: candid 是形容詞，沒有動詞用法；向董事會說明應改用 disclosed 或 admitted。
distractorExplanations.d: candid with 後面接的是傾訴的對象（be candid with somebody），不能接動名詞；此處應說 candid enough to admit。

options.text: The police ensued a chaotic scene outside the stadium later that evening.
The chaotic scene was ensued by the announcement of the cancellation.
A chaotic scene ensued as soon as the cancellation was finally announced.
The chaotic scene ensued to the announcement made over the loudspeakers.

explanation: ensue 是不及物動詞，主語就是「後來發生的那件事」（chaos ensued、a debate ensued）；它沒有受詞，也沒有被動式，要點明起因時用 ensue from + 名詞。

distractorExplanations.a: ensue 不能帶受詞；要表達警方的作為應改用 broke up 或 attended。
distractorExplanations.b: ensue 不及物，因此沒有被動式；此處應說 The announcement was followed by a chaotic scene。
distractorExplanations.d: ensue 不搭配 to；交代起因要用 from：a chaotic scene ensued from the announcement。

prompt: Choose the word that best completes the sentence.
context: Several younger architects openly seek to ____ the Finnish master whose handling of natural light they studied so closely as students.
explanation: emulate 的受詞是令人景仰的人或其成就，意思是「以之為榜樣，設法追上甚至超越」，因此才能接 the Finnish master 這樣的人物受詞。

distractorExplanations.a: simulate 指用模型或裝置模擬某種狀態或過程（simulate daylight / an earthquake），受詞不能是一個人。
distractorExplanations.c: replicate 的受詞是可以原樣重現的結果或實驗（replicate the findings），指精確複製，而非見賢思齊。
distractorExplanations.d: impersonate 指假冒他人身分或模仿其言行以娛樂觀眾，語意與語域都與專業上的效法不同。

options.text: The new ruling rendered the clause to be unenforceable in every member state.
The new ruling rendered that the clause was unenforceable in every member state.
The new ruling rendered the clause as unenforceable in every member state at once.
The new ruling rendered the clause unenforceable in every member state overnight.

explanation: render 的論元結構是 render + 受詞 + 形容詞（render something useless、render somebody unable to work）：形容詞直接跟在受詞後面當補語，中間不插入任何字。

distractorExplanations.a: render 不接 to be；補語直接用形容詞即可。接 to be 的是 consider、believe 這類動詞。
distractorExplanations.b: render 不接 that 子句；要用子句必須改寫成 ruled that the clause was unenforceable。
distractorExplanations.c: render 不搭配 as；接 as + 補語的是 regard、describe、see 這類動詞。
